runners.comment: Third on handicap debut at Ayr (2m, soft) last March but this season has been a struggle
runners.name: Bray Dale
runners.spotlight: Third on handicap debut at Ayr (2m, soft) last March but this season has been a struggle; 3lb wrong today; visor replaces cheekpieces.

17:15.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Winning hurdler (2m4f) who has shown promise on both chase starts; first rules run at 3m
runners.name: Casual Observer
runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate - Casual Ob
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler (2m4f, heavy) who has shown promise in defeat over 2m4f on his two chase starts (soft); now steps up to 3m for first time under rules (was second in a 3m point).

runners.comment: Won this race in 2025; not run quite as well since; a possible with new headgear tried
runners.name: Lady In The Park
runners.spotlight: Won this race in first-time blinkers off a pound lower mark 12 months ago (good to soft); hasn't run quite as well in three starts this season and now tried in a visor; a possible.

runners.comment: Maiden; creditable second on chase debut at Carlisle earlier this month; interesting
runners.name: Loulou Madrik
runners.spotlight: Yet to win a race; shaped with plenty of promise when second on chase debut at Carlisle earlier this month (3m, good); has shown fair form on soft ground; interesting with tongue-tie now tried.

runners.comment: Hat-trick in 2024; hasn't been in the same form since; well treated but plenty to prove
runners.name: William Of York
runners.spotlight: Hat-trick of wins over fences on last three starts two seasons ago (2m3f-2m5f, good to soft-heavy); hasn't run anything like as well since and although 13lb lower than last winning mark, has plenty to prove at present.

runners.comment: Only chase win was over 3m7f in February 2024; struggled to win since; on a good mark now
runners.name: Inis Oirr
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been at Musselburgh, latest a 3m7f handicap chase in February 2024 (good to soft); struggled to win since, but is well handicapped.

runners.comment: Two novice h'caps wins earlier in the season; excuse for poor run last time; not out of it
runners.name: Sir Carnegie
runners.spotlight: Won novice handicaps over this trip at Newcastle (good) and Kelso (good to soft) earlier in the season; not in quite such good form since but excuses for heavy defeat at Newcastle last time (bad mistake five out); not out of it.

runners.comment: Newcastle win in January; in the frame since, latest from 9lb out the h'cap; could go well
runners.name: Uptown Harry
runners.spotlight: Veteran; C&D winner in 2021; having a good season, winning at Newcastle in January (2m7f, good to soft) and in the frame on his three runs since, last time when 9lb wrong; runs off his true mark here; could go well.

runners.breeder: Mme Elza Petit & Mme Hannah Petit
runners.comment: C&D winner on chase debut in September; may have needed the run after a break last time
runners.name: Burgundy Man
runners.spotlight: Made a winning debut over fences over C&D in October (soft); bit disappointing when returning from a break when well beaten at Kelso last time (2m5f, good) but should come on for the run.

runners.comment: Won over 3m at Ayr in March and fair effort last time; conditions suit; worth considering
runners.name: Nights In Venice
runners.spotlight: Both wins have been at Ayr, latest over 3m in March (soft); not disgraced down in trip last time; one to consider.

runners.comment: Ex-Fergal O'Brien last term; below par this season; plenty to prove on her chase debut
runners.name: Jakana
runners.spotlight: Won twice over hurdles for Fergal O'Brien last season; has fared less well for new yard and, having been pulled up wearing headgear on last three starts, has plenty to prove on her chase debut (no headgear this time).

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras Du Luy
runners.comment: 0-11; placed all 5 starts chasing (last of three in cheekpieces latest); each-way chance
runners.name: Jirko
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden; placed on all five starts over fences this term, although was disappointing when last of three with cheekpieces tried at Ayr last time (2m4f, soft; didn't jump well); headgear retained; each-way chance.

13:52.race_name: Book Attraction Restaurant Online Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: One of the main contenders on penultimate effort; ready for a crack at this new trip
runners.name: Al Maslool
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced colt who made no impression at Yarmouth (kept to 1m) on turf debut most recently but may be ready for a crack at this longer distance; one of the main contenders on penultimate effort, namely 1l third at Lingfield (AW).

runners.comment: 20,000gns 2yo; by Teofilo; one of several newcomers in the field; market instructive
runners.name: Barak Warrior
runners.owner: W Sweatman J Summers R Foden
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros yearling, 20,000gns 2yo; by Teofilo and first foal of twice-raced (RPR 62) daughter of Irish 1,000 Guineas winner; one of several newcomers in the field; market instructive.

runners.comment: Fared better upped to 1m2f at Bath; related to a few winners for his yard; respected
runners.name: Cape Fear
runners.spotlight: Seemed in need of the experience and/or found 1m on the sharp side in sole 2yo start; fared better with third-place finish upped to 1m2f at Bath (good) on reappearance and is bred to do better still, being related to a few winners for his yard; respected.

runners.comment: 40,000gns yearling; this debutant represents an in-form stable; interesting
runners.name: Its Debatable
runners.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; brother to French 1m/1m4f winner Dixmude; dam US 8.5f turf scorer, half-sister to winners Vue Fantastique (1m2f Group 3) and Calling Out (1m 2yo Listed); this debutant represents an in-form stable; interesting.

runners.comment: 65,000euros yearling; from family of Group 1 scorers; nicely bred newcomer
runners.name: Le Morbihan
runners.spotlight: 65,000euros yearling; by Sea The Moon; dam unraced sister to 7f/8.6f 2yo winner Pomelo, half-sister to Group 1 scorers Bluestocking (1m2f/1m4f including Arc) and Qirat (1m Sussex Stakes); nicely bred newcomer.

runners.comment: Godolphin debutant by Masar out of 7f winner; heed the market signals
runners.name: Fighters Spirit
runners.spotlight: Godolphin debutant by Masar out of French 7f-winning (RPR 80) half-sister to Listed scorers Promesse De L'Aube (German 1m2f), Elite Army (1m4f) and Pure Diamond (UAE 7f); heed the market signals.

runners.comment: Appeared to run well at Thirsk last time but looks one for handicaps
runners.name: Mayflower Billy
runners.spotlight: Outsider in both starts; appeared to run well, finishing fourth, at Thirsk (1m) switched to turf on reappearance but looks the type who'll find better opportunities in handicaps shortly.

runners.comment: May improve with Doncaster reappearance under his belt and this seems an easier race
runners.name: Three No Trumps
runners.spotlight: Belied his 100-1 odds with close third at Kempton (1m, AW) in sole 2yo run; posted a lesser effort when 25-1 at Doncaster (1m2f) on reappearance but may improve with the outing under his belt and this seems a slightly easier race.

14:22.race_name: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.comment: Bred to be a good sprinter; very slowly away but some promise on debut; can improve
runners.name: Arrbob
runners.spotlight: Dam had some speedy siblings, including Group 3 winner Strath Burn; 20-1 for debut in the Brocklesby at Doncaster (5f, good to soft) in March where he was very slowly away but showed some minor promise thereafter; this stiffer test may well suit and can expect improvement.

runners.comment: Early foal; £26,000 yearling; has been gelded; market can guide
runners.name: Disbelief
runners.spotlight: January foal; 11,000gns foal, £26,000 yearling; first foal; by Ubettabelieveit out of 7f/1m maiden (RPR 41), half-sister to winners All Star Cast (French Listed-placed 7f 2yo) and Manuha (1m); has been gelded; yard had a shortish-priced beginner run respectably this month; market can guide.

runners.comment: Out of 5f winner; yard won this last year and already had a winning 2yo newcomer in 2026
runners.name: Matteo
runners.spotlight: February foal; 43,000euros yearling by Coulsty; fourth foal; half-brother to 6f AW winner Alainn Tu (RPR 58); dam 5f 2yo winner (90), half-sister to Listed-placed 7f/1m winner Sensei; yard has already unearthed a good winning 2yo newcomer this year (favourite) and won this with a beginner last April; likely type.

runners.comment: Useful sprinting pedigree; yard has low strike-rate in 2yo maiden/novices in recent years
runners.name: Ronson
runners.spotlight: February foal; second foal; by Ubettabelieveit out of 6f winner (RPR 57), half-sister to several winners including Bahuta Acha (5f/6f including 2yo; RPR 84) and Mininggold (5f/6f including 2yo; 82); yard has low strike-rate in 2yo maiden and novice events in recent years; likely other days.

runners.comment: 7,000euros yearling; likely best watched against 2yos with speedier pedigrees
runners.name: Concert Pitch
runners.spotlight: February foal; 7,000euros yearling; sixth foal; by Kuroshio; half-brother to winners Philos (1m4f/1m6f AW; RPR 67) and Cham's Pride (Spanish 9.5f including 2yo); dam French 9.5f turf/10.7f AW winner; looks best watched making debut against 2yos with speedier pedigrees.

runners.comment: 16,000gns yearling; no surprise if this 5f proves on the sharp side on debut
runners.name: Craven Force
runners.owner: Craven Surface Mrs T Burns & Partners
runners.spotlight: February foal; 16,000gns yearling; sixth foal; by Caturra; half-brother to winners Make Us Proud (1m4f/1m7f including AW/Australia; RPR 95) and Sesame Birah (Listed-placed 7f 2yo; 93); dam 1m4f AW winner (79); no surprise if this 5f proves on the sharp side.

runners.comment: 28-1 for recent C&D debut when finishing at the back of the pack; unlikely this time
runners.name: Amantha
runners.spotlight: 28-1 for her recent debut over C&D when slowly away and finished at the back of the pack; unlikely for now; yard also runs Concert Pitch.

runners.comment: Useful sprinting pedigree; yard 1-7 with 2yos here in last five years; market check needed
runners.name: Beautiful Rainbow
runners.spotlight: April foal; 40,000euros yearling; first foal; by Cotai Glory out of 6f 2yo/1m winner (RPR 83) whose winning siblings include Amadeus Wolf (6f 2yo Group 1) and Rouleau (6f 2yo Group 3); bred to go a bit and yard 1-7 with 2yos here in last five years; market check needed.

runners.comment: 31,000euros yearling; yard 3-6 with 2yos here; market should be helpful
runners.name: Half A Hoof
runners.spotlight: March foal; 31,000euros yearling; eighth foal; Lucky Vega half-sister to winners including Fullness Of Life (Italian 6f-1m including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 99) and Sopran Brescia (Italian 1m1f-1m3f); dam Italian 6f 2yo winner; yard had few turf runners this year but 3-6 with 2yos here; market helpful.

runners.comment: Quite promising debut 3rd over C&D (40-1) last week; open to improvement
runners.name: Lauralynn
runners.owner: Ger ONeill & Unique Retreats Stays Ltd
runners.spotlight: Suffered a wide passage on C&D debut (good to soft; 40-1) last week where she shaped quite nicely, losing second only late on behind a smart newcomer; should improve but there are dangers among the newcomers.

runners.comment: Unraced here but this stiff 5f can suit and he's back on same mark as latest Sandown win
runners.name: Jenever
runners.spotlight: Unraced on this course but some of his best form has come over Sandown's similarly stiff 5f and he's back on the same mark as his latest win there last June (good; a race he'd won 12 months earlier); every chance of being seen to good effect back on turf.

runners.comment: All best form at 6f on good or quicker; lacks recent run and now has first-ever run at 5f
runners.name: Novello Lad
runners.spotlight: All best form at 6f on good or quicker ground; easily excused a modest farewell to 2025 on account of soft going but he does have something to prove in his first-ever 5f run.

runners.comment: Won over 6f in France as 2yo; high in weights since; may need more weight off her back
runners.name: Arctic Summer
runners.spotlight: Won over 6f in France (very soft) as 2yo; couldn't cope with high marks in Britain last year and made no serious impact on reappearance at Doncaster (6f, good to soft) last month; may need more weight off her back.

runners.comment: Won two of three C&D starts; on losing run but went close on AW latest; solid claims
runners.name: Ventura Express
runners.spotlight: Has won two of three C&D starts (good and good to firm), the latest in July 2024; went very close to breaking the losing run when involved in a tight finish on Southwell AW in March; convincing claims.

runners.comment: 3-11 in handicaps; decent reappearance 2nd over C&D last week; due 1lb rise
runners.name: Im Next
runners.spotlight: Has won three of 11 handicaps (heavy/AW/good to soft; acts on good to firm), also runner-up to strong candidates on two occasions, including when losing his lead near the line over C&D last week; solid chance off the same mark; due 1lb rise.

runners.comment: Impressive C&D winner last April on sole course start; handily weighted and can go well
runners.name: Trilby
runners.spotlight: Three of five wins have come at Haydock but he found an impressive finish when winning over C&D (good) last April on sole course start; on his lowest mark since the summer of 2024 and can go well with tongue-tie refitted.

runners.comment: Powerful front-running win over C&D in August; unlucky in running on recent AW return
runners.name: Tees Aggregates
runners.owner: Ingleby Bloodstock Ltd & The Ivy League
runners.spotlight: Can be slowly away but he showed no mercy to his rivals when making all over C&D (good to firm) last August; returned from a long winter break with an unlucky run on Southwell AW 16 days ago and he's one to be interested in back on this track; yard won race in 2022.

runners.comment: Two 5f wins as 2yo; tough in 2025 but only just touched off at Pontefract on Tuesday
runners.name: Fuji Mountain
runners.spotlight: Two 5f wins at Chester (good to soft and soft) as 2yo; had a tough 3yo season as a result but there were signs of life off a reduced mark in the autumn and he only just lost out at Pontefract (5f, good; first-time blinkers) on Tuesday; bang there if turning out again.

runners.comment: Two AW wins at 5f in early 2025; below par in the autumn; first turf run for nearly a year
runners.name: Until Dawn
runners.owner: F Reay S McMillan & S Pedersen
runners.spotlight: Two 5f wins on the AW early in 2025 but she was well below her best on sand in the autumn; has had wind surgery since but the suitability of this track is in doubt now back on turf for the first time in nearly a year.

15:22.race_name: Alan McGuinness And Robin Lunness Memorial Handicap

runners.comment: Last two efforts can be excused; steadily progressive otherwise; gained sole win over C&D
runners.name: A War Eagle
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo whose last two efforts, latest on stable/seasonal debut, can be excused; steadily progressive RPRs otherwise and gained sole success over C&D (good to firm); interesting back down in class and returned to this scenario.

runners.comment: Escapes penalty for Ripon win last week; drawn wide but otherwise holds strong claims
runners.name: Milteye
runners.owner: Rise One Racing And W A Bethell
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly on good ground or softer; tactically versatile; overcame traffic issues to get up in the final strides in apprentice race at Ripon (1m) last week, taking turf record to 5-20; drawn wide but otherwise has strong claims with penalty avoided; future mark 3lb higher.

runners.comment: Ran well when last seen but isn't crying out for this step back up in distance
runners.name: Lord Roxby
runners.owner: N Skinner D Jenkins J Glover
runners.spotlight: Campaigned mostly over sprint trips and gained his Beverley win at 5f (also effective at 6f); close second at Newmarket when last seen but doesn't appear to be crying out for this step back up in distance.

runners.comment: Won at Newmarket in most recent turf attempt; possibilities back in this sphere
runners.name: Nyman
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo whose form (three attempts) for new yard features a win at Newmarket (7f, good to soft) last backend; possibilities returned to turf with AW reappearance (midfield) under his belt.

runners.comment: Chance depends on whether he can transfer good AW form back to turf; 1-12 in this sphere
runners.name: Priapos
runners.spotlight: Proved suited by the switch to AW towards the end of his 2025 campaign and nearly completed a 1m hat-trick on final outing; chance depends on whether he can keep up the good form returned to turf; only 1-12 in this sphere and 10lb higher than last attempt.

runners.comment: 2lb below last winning mark; fighting chance provided he rebounds
runners.name: Capital Guarantee
runners.spotlight: Has failed to show his form in last four appearances but ground softer than good wasn't ideal on seasonal debut latest; 2lb below last winning mark and holds a fighting chance provided he rebounds.

runners.comment: Made all at Southwell when last seen; could make another bold bid; stable 3-5 this month
runners.name: Frostmagic
runners.spotlight: Has won over middle distances, including on turf, but seems to need shorter nowadays and made all over 1m at Southwell (AW) when last seen; could make a bold bid on this track provided he again goes from the front; stable going very well (3-5 with big LSP) this month; respected.

runners.comment: Drawn against the inner rail and could be a danger provided he's in top form
runners.name: Highfield Viking
runners.spotlight: Gained last year's two wins in August but has recorded his other two successes (2023/2024) in the month of April; drawn against the inner rail and could be a danger, provided he's in top form on seasonal debut; market support would heighten interest.

runners.comment: Lightly raced; return to this C&D may have positive effect on stable/seasonal debut
runners.name: Surprised
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo whose solid record in novice events, including 2yo success over C&D, has not been transferred to two handicaps; sold out of Ed Bethell's yard for £6,000 since last run; return to this scenario may have positive effect on stable/seasonal debut.

runners.comment: Form for current yard features a few second-place finishes that represent peak form
runners.name: Yaajooz
runners.spotlight: Gained sole win in July 2024 on final start for previous yard; record of 0-9 for current stable doesn't tell the whole story as he's posted a few second-place finishes that represent peak form; capable of going well.

runners.comment: On a two-year losing spell; 0-4 for current stable; off since November
runners.name: Tropez Power
runners.spotlight: Gained sole turf success in 2021 and it's two years since last AW win; 0-4 for current stable and lacks recent match practice having been absent since November; probably best watched unless the market suggests otherwise.

runners.comment: Frame possibilities, provided her consistent run of form continues on reappearance
runners.name: Valley Of Flowers
runners.spotlight: Ended last season with a spell of consistent efforts and has frame possibilities provided she returns in similar form; whether she can end a losing spell is another matter (no win since 2023).

runners.comment: Scored in first-time cheekpieces on penultimate start; now goes in visor; one to consider
runners.name: Naval Tribute
runners.spotlight: Has worn cheekpieces since switched to handicaps, winning at Kempton (1m3f) then below par at Lingfield, both on AW; may rebound and have more to offer, provided he responds well to the fitting of visor.

runners.comment: Back up in grade but may build on Catterick win and have more to offer in the cheekpieces
runners.name: Roland Garros
runners.spotlight: Needed a drop to Class 6 to open his account in Catterick event (1m4f, good) last time; back up in grade but may build on that win and also have more to offer in the retained cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Completed a turf double last July; ran creditably on AW reappearance; respected
runners.name: Iwantmytimewithyou
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who completed a turf double (1m4f/1m6f) last July; creditable second at Kempton (1m4f, AW) on reappearance; has shown all that best form in Class 6 but may do better still this term; respected.

runners.comment: Six course wins, the most recent last August in last 1m4f attempt; could go well
runners.name: Dr Rio
runners.spotlight: Veteran who is 6-23 at Beverley, the most recent success last August in last 1m4f attempt; could go well returned to this scenario with Catterick reappearance (7f) under his belt.

runners.comment: Ran encouragingly on seasonal debut; defied a much higher mark at Beverley in 2022
runners.name: Kitsune Power
runners.spotlight: Defied a much higher mark at Beverley in 2022; poor strike-rate since but he ran encouragingly when favourite at Catterick (1m4f) on seasonal debut and has possibilities back here, being so nicely weighted.

runners.breeder: Whitsbury Manor Stud And Mrs M E Slade
runners.comment: Beaten only 2l over C&D last week, taking Beverley record to 1423234; solid chance
runners.name: Freddy Robinson
runners.spotlight: Gained most recent win in handicap hurdle in December; beaten only 2l over C&D last week, taking Beverley record to 1423234; hasn't scored on Flat since June 2024 but looks a solid contender kept to this venue.

runners.comment: Scored readily on AW on Monday; 5lb penalty is offset by Mason Paetel's claim; respected
runners.name: No Knee Never
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-8 on turf but he ran well at Yarmouth on penultimate start and readily justified favouritism at Lingfield (1m) on Monday for a third AW win; 5lb penalty is offset by Mason Paetel's useful claim; respected.

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: Seven-race maiden whose form has dipped sharply for current yard
runners.name: Habari
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden whose form has dipped sharply for current yard and who lacks recent practice (absent since last August); best watched unless the betting suggests otherwise.

runners.comment: Gained sole turf success over C&D; made the frame in both starts this year; solid chance
runners.name: Tees George
runners.spotlight: Gained sole turf success over C&D (in September 2024) and returns to Beverley in reasonably good form, having made the frame in both outings this year, latest in big field at Doncaster (1m); solid claims.

runners.comment: Only 1lb higher than when scoring on AW in December; fighting chance if back to form
runners.name: Moonlight Bomb
runners.spotlight: Has lacked consistency for current stable but is only 1lb higher than when recording an account-opening success on AW in December; fighting chance provided he's back in similar form.

runners.comment: Ten-race maiden who has frame possibilities on several pieces of form
runners.name: Drumcondra
runners.spotlight: Ten-race maiden who has frame possibilities on several pieces of form, including a couple of second-place finishes at Musselburgh last term and fourth-place finish on AW reappearance.

runners.comment: Solid record this year comprises two good AW efforts and a hurdles win; possibilities
runners.name: Maple
runners.owner: R Whitelock L Clemitson & R Jefferson
runners.spotlight: Solid record this year comprises a couple of second-places finishes at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) then success at Sedgefield (2m1f) returned to hurdles; 0-7 on Flat but has possibilities in current form.

runners.comment: Has reverted to inconsistent ways since last September; others preferred
runners.name: Woodleigh
runners.spotlight: Has reverted to inconsistent ways since last September, notwithstanding a Redcar success (1m2f); perhaps needed the run at Doncaster (1m) on reappearance but needs to step up plenty on that effort.

runners.comment: Interesting off a handy mark back over this C&D with Thirsk reappearance under his belt
runners.name: Copper And Five
runners.owner: Mrs Sally Doyle And Mrs Ruth Carr
runners.spotlight: Veteran who gained most recently success in C&D contest (off 5lb higher) last May on second start of his 2025 campaign; reasonably interesting returned to this scenario with Thirsk reappearance under his belt.

runners.comment: Placed at Bath returned to turf last time; recorded sole win in AW classified race
runners.name: Man Is King
runners.spotlight: Holds an each-way squeak, having been placed at Bath (1m) returned to turf last time, but looks no certainty to double his tally; record is just 1-49, the success in AW classified race in February.

runners.comment: Record over C&D, all off higher marks, reads 112; interesting back in this scenario
runners.name: Coolree
runners.spotlight: Took AW score to 0-16 with two below-par efforts on AW for new stable during the winter; record over C&D, all off higher marks in Class 5, reads 112; interesting back in this scenario and in this lower grade, with a return to form on the cards.

runners.comment: Still a maiden but has possibilities on the pick of his form; debut for another new yard
runners.name: Glitter Code
runners.spotlight: Sold for 9,000gns since his sole start (2m) for Micky Hammond; still a maiden and drops back markedly in trip but has possibilities on the pick of his form for William Knight; wears new headgear on debut for Ed Bethell; market may offer further guidance.

runners.breeder: J A Knox And Mrs M A Knox
runners.comment: Form over C&D last year comprised a second-place finish in this race and a success
runners.name: Hostelry
runners.spotlight: Couple of duck eggs this term leave a doubt over her current form; however, gained one of her five wins in 2025 over this C&D and she holds a good chance off current mark provided a resurgence materialises; runner-up in this race 12 months ago.

runners.comment: Three course wins, albeit in the summer months; sixth of 14 at Thirsk on reappearance
runners.name: Sunny Orange
runners.spotlight: Three-time course winner, albeit in the summer months; may not be ready to strike but it's difficult to rule out a good effort with Thirsk reappearance (sixth of 14) under his belt.

runners.comment: Gained most recent win over C&D; generally consistent since; solid chance
runners.name: Hashtagnotions
runners.spotlight: Record is 4-23, the most recent win last September in sole C&D attempt (soft); generally consistent since, respectable fifth at Doncaster (1m2f) most recently; gained other turf success on good ground; solid.

runners.comment: Far from solid on 2026 form for new yard; best watched
runners.name: Mini Mac
runners.spotlight: One win apiece for his previous two yards but looks far from solid on 2026 form for another new stable; best watched unless the betting suggests a big run is likely.

runners.comment: Enough to prove back up in trip on stable/seasonal debut
runners.name: Bantz
runners.spotlight: Eventually lost his form for Gemma Tutty, having scored twice over 7f earlier in 2025; sold for 4,500gns and gelded since last run; enough to prove back up in trip on reappearance but market support should be heeded.

runners.comment: Best form on ground softer than good; usual hood removed
runners.name: Dinah Myte
runners.spotlight: Best form, including sole success, on ground softer than good; perhaps unsuited by AW this year but again seems unlikely to have ideal conditions and removal of usual hood presents another question mark.

runners.comment: Placed at Nottingham last Saturday returned to turf but still has a poor strike-rate
runners.name: Bizarre Law
runners.spotlight: Has an each-way shout, having shown signs of a revival with placed effort at Nottingham (1m) last Saturday returned to turf; whether he can win is another matter, with his strike-rate still poor.

17:25.race_name: Racing Again On Bank Holiday Monday Handicap

runners.comment: Brings possible sources of improvement; not ruled out
runners.name: Barbury Boy
runners.spotlight: Not exactly solid on autumn novice form (7f/1m) but brings sources of possible improvement, namely a gelding operation, switch to handicap level and new trip; not ruled out.

runners.comment: May improve for the change of trip/surface; interesting
runners.name: Von Dutch
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden whose AW efforts (8.5f/1m4f) this year suggest this switch to 1m2f will prove optimal; likewise pedigree suggests the switch to turf will suit; interesting.

runners.comment: Switch to turf may prompt progress on handicap debut
runners.name: Alice De Clare
runners.spotlight: Thrice-raced filly who is a similar type to Von Dutch, being one whose breeding suggests the switch to turf may prompt progress; interesting handicap debutante.

runners.comment: Far from solid on 2yo maiden form
runners.name: Duchess T
runners.spotlight: Far from solid on 2yo maiden form, having finished last in races either side of an effort that may not be reliable; treat with caution unless the market speaks favourably.

runners.comment: Gives impression this first crack at 1m2f may suit
runners.name: Hengist Pod
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who has inconsistent form and finished last of four on turf debut (1m4f) most recently; however, gives impression this first crack at 1m2f may suit.

runners.comment: Holds weak claims on AW form; turf/handicap debut
runners.name: My Dad Frank
runners.owner: S McMillan F Reay & A D Brown
runners.spotlight: Holds weak claims on AW efforts and chance depends on how well he responds to this new scenario, which is a first attempt over 1m2f on turf/handicap debut.

runners.comment: Brings a few possible sources of improvement; considered
runners.name: Keep It Classic
runners.spotlight: Four-race maiden who seems one of the lesser lights at his major yard but may show improvement now handicapping, upped in distance (from 7f) and fitted with headgear; shortlisted.

runners.comment: May improve for this further move upward in trip
runners.name: Laser Luck
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who has shown no progress since switched to handicaps; however, pedigree suggests this further move upward in trip may spark a bigger effort.

runners.comment: Modest fourth on last two starts; needs improvement
runners.name: Contemplation
runners.spotlight: Modest fourth in 12.5f AW handicap and 1m turf maiden in last two outings (stable debut latest); needs improvement.

runners.comment: Finished last in all 2yo starts
runners.name: Dream Of Ithaca
runners.spotlight: Handicap debutante who needs to have improved markedly over the winter, having finished last in all 2yo starts.

runners.comment: Ran well in AW contest on seasonal debut; possibilities
runners.name: Smoker Bellamy
runners.spotlight: Five-race maiden who ran well, beating all bar the market leader, at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) on seasonal debut; possibilities off same mark, provided he builds on that effort.

runners.comment: Showed some improvement on handicap/seasonal debut
runners.name: Jambearee
runners.spotlight: Only eighth of 11 but showed improvement on RPRs at Kempton (1m4f) on handicap/seasonal debut, while shaping as if this return to shorter will suit; could go well.

runners.comment: Needs to improve sharply on stable debut
runners.name: Lynxman
runners.spotlight: Achieved meagre RPRs last term for Jack Morland, latterly in handicaps; ran below market expectations the final time; needs to improve sharply on debut for new stable.

runners.comment: Pulled well clear with a subsequent winner on his debut at Kempton (7f); has strong claims
runners.name: Golden View
runners.spotlight: Dam 7f-1m winner (including 2yo/AW/German Group 3; RPR 107); made a winning debut when sent off odds-on favourite at Kempton (7f, AW) in December, pulling well clear with the runner-up who has won since; should have no problem with this step up in trip and he looks a strong challenger to Yazin.

runners.comment: 2-2 in France, winning over 6.5f and 1m on soft ground; makes his stable/British debut
runners.name: Intense Vision
runners.spotlight: Dam 7f 2yo winner (RPR 90); 2-2 in France, winning a maiden at Craon (6.5f, soft) in September then a conditions event at Bordeaux Le Bouscat (1m, very soft) in October; has been off since and now makes his stable/British debut having been purchased for 60,000gns; watch the betting.

runners.comment: Made it 2-3 when winning at Newmarket (form franked); the one to beat on his return
runners.name: Yazin
runners.spotlight: Built on his debut effort when ending up a comfortable winner at Redcar (7f, good to soft) in September; took another step forward when winning a novice under a penalty at Newmarket (7f, good) in October when last seen, form that has been franked with six of those behind winning since; had wind surgery since; stepping up in trip should prove no issue and he looks the one to beat on his return.

17:30.race_name: Celebrate With Sponsorship At Southwell Racecourse Handicap

runners.comment: Failed to progress from his debut last year but ran respectably at Bath on his return
runners.name: Believeinmenow
runners.spotlight: Failed to progress from his promising debut last year but he was beaten only 3l when ninth of 19 in a competitive nursery at York (6f, good to firm; first-time hood) last August; had been gelded prior to a a respectable reappearance at Bath (5f, good; raced freely) 18 days ago; now makes his AW debut with solid claims.

runners.comment: Beaten a neck over C&D on debut and this drop back to 5f should suit on h'cap debut
runners.name: Blue Deveron
runners.spotlight: Beaten a neck over this C&D in January on debut but he failed to build on that at Wolverhampton next time; left the impression this drop back to 5f would suit when third at Chelmsford (6f, AW; second has won since) 28 days ago; contender on this handicap debut.

runners.comment: Runner-up at Lingfield in January but failed to beat a rival on his stable debut
runners.name: Beach Partee
runners.spotlight: Won three times for William Knight, two of which came on the AW; runner-up at Lingfield (5f) in January but he failed to built a rival at Bath (5f, good) on his stable debut 18 days ago; needs to take a step forward from that effort.

runners.comment: Form figures of 121 over 5f (both wins over C&D); respected off this 4lb higher mark
runners.name: Life After Love
runners.spotlight: Has form figures of 121 over 5f, with both of the wins coming over this C&D, the most recent by a neck 28 days ago; the third has won since and she's respected off this 4lb higher mark.

runners.comment: Got off the mark in a first-time visor at Wolverhampton last month; disappointing latest
runners.name: Sands Of Seve
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark when making all in a first-time visor at Wolverhampton (5f, AW) last month but he was comfortably held at Lingfield 27 days ago having been raised 9lb for that success; needs to bounce back.

18:00.race_name: Dog Friendly Raceday Tues 2nd June Handicap

runners.comment: Well held at Lingfield last time and is without a win on the Flat since the end of 2023
runners.name: Vaguely Royal
runners.spotlight: Didn't run too badly when sixth here over 2m2f on his penultimate start but he was well held at Lingfield (2m, AW) 20 days ago; without a win on the Flat since the end of 2023 and needs to bounce back.

runners.comment: Hung left when third in a novice here over 1m4f last time; looks worth a go over this trip
runners.name: John Galt
runners.spotlight: Shaped with encouragement on his handicap debut at Wolverhampton (1m4f, AW) last month but didn't help himself by hanging left when third of nine in a novice here over 1m4f 18 days ago (tongue-tie and cheekpieces were on for the first time); looks worth a try over this longer trip and he can be competitive returned to a handicap.

runners.comment: Dual C&D winner who was unfortunate not to go closer at Pontefract last time; good claims
runners.name: Swinging London
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner; beaten 2l when fourth of six here last month and he was unfortunate not to go even closer when fourth of 12 at Pontefract (1m4f, good to soft; short of room late on) 16 days ago; switches back to the AW with a good chance.

runners.comment: Five-time winner in Ireland; gives impression he may come on from his return at Kempton
runners.name: The Truant
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner in Ireland (hurdles/Flat) but he was well held in two starts for this yard at the end of last year; however, he seemed to be going quite well at the top of the straight before weakening into seventh at Kempton (2m, AW) 17 days ago and may take a step forward from that return to action.

runners.breeder: Mountain View Stud & J C B/Stock
runners.comment: Won over 1m6f at Yarmouth last year; disappointing when last seen but may bounce back
runners.name: Captain Brett
runners.spotlight: Showed improvement when stepping up in trip last year, including a win at Yarmouth (1m6f, good); disappointing at Newmarket (1m6f, good to firm) when last seen 257 days ago but the break may have done him some good.

18:30.race_name: Book The Bistro In Sherwood Restaurant Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Beat two rivals in a maiden at Lingfield in November; needs to build on his Kempton return
runners.name: Marnier
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when beating two rivals in good style in a maiden at Lingfield (1m4f, AW) in November but he dropped away up the straight having taken a grip in a handicap at Kempton on his return 17 days ago; needs to build on that.

runners.comment: Three-time winner on the AW (1m6f-2m); below his best when last seen; drops back in trip
runners.name: New York Minute
runners.spotlight: Won his last two starts for Ralph Beckett and completed the hat-trick here over 2m in November when visored for the first time on his debut for this stable; ran another good race when runner-up at Kempton (2m) next time but he was below his best 97 days ago; could bounce back on his first start since but this drop back in trip may not be ideal.

runners.comment: First past the post at Beverley last year; failed to beat a rival at Meydan; back in trip
runners.name: Desert Shadow
runners.spotlight: First past the post (demoted to second having caused interference) in a handicap at Beverley last August but he failed to beat a rival at Meydan (1m4f, good) 41 days ago; dropping back in trip should suit and he may bounce back on his return to Britain.

runners.breeder: New England Stud & Stanley House Stud
runners.comment: Has switched yards since winning at Chelmsford in August; should have more to offer
runners.name: Lady Ridgewood
runners.spotlight: Finished third of five at Brighton (1m2f, good to firm) on her handicap debut last April, form that has been well franked by the winner, and got off the mark at the fifth attempt when landing a maiden at Chelmsford (1m2f, AW) on her final start for Peter Chapple-Hyam; has since changed yards (same owner) having been off since and could have more to offer.

runners.comment: Made a winning stable debut at Lingfield last month; couldn't build on that at Yarmouth
runners.name: Yaa Min
runners.spotlight: Got off to the perfect start for this stable when narrowly coming out on top at Lingfield (1m4f, AW) last month but wasn't able to build on that at Yarmouth (1m2f, good) 12 days ago; place claims back on the AW.

runners.comment: Possibly didn't handle Newmarket when last seen; gelded since; could bounce back
runners.name: Elsass
runners.spotlight: Sole win came by a nose at Chelmsford (1m2f, AW) last August and he ran well when second of nine at Kempton (1m3f, AW) next time; possibly didn't handle the undulations of Newmarket (1m4f) in the Old Rowley Cup when last seen and has since been gelded; could be capable of bouncing back returned to the AW.

19:00.race_name: Come Racing For Free 18th June Handicap

runners.comment: Posted a much improved effort when winning comfortably on his h'cap debut; the one to beat
runners.name: Raspoutine
runners.spotlight: Held in four starts on turf last year but he posted a much improved effort when switched to the AW on his handicap debut at Lingfield nine days ago, kicking off the bend before being eased late on; 6lb well-in under a penalty and he's the one to beat.

runners.comment: Below his best on turf latest but was in good form on the AW prior to that; blinkers on
runners.name: Aneirins Sword
runners.spotlight: Below his best at Nottingham (8.5f, good) 15 days ago but he had been in good form on the AW prior to that, with form figures of 1222123 since the beginning of the year; may bounce back returned to the AW with blinkers on for the first time.

runners.comment: Won by 6l at Wolverhampton last month and went close there again last time; can go well
runners.name: Lexington Express
runners.spotlight: Posted an improved effort when winning by 6l at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) last month, despite hanging right, and backed that up when going close over that same C&D 19 days ago; can again go well.

runners.comment: Failed to build on his maiden efforts when fourth of five on his handicap debut; up to 1m
runners.name: Clear Above
runners.spotlight: Ran to a similar level in two maiden events at Newcastle and Southwell (both over 7f), but he failed to build on those efforts on his handicap debut at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) two weeks ago; steps up to 1m with better needed.

runners.comment: Struggled in three maiden events; much better needed on handicap debut; watch the betting
runners.name: Action Reaction
runners.spotlight: Struggled in three maiden events (1m/7f) in March and April (beaten 33l and 22l in two of them); much better is needed on her handicap debut but the betting should be informative.

runners.comment: Sent off big prices and never threatened in three novice events here; handicap debut
runners.name: Cobalt Comet
runners.spotlight: Sent off big prices and never threatened in three novice events at this track (two over C&D); open to improvement but he's best watched on his handicap debut.

19:30.race_name: Conference & Events At Southwell Racecourse Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C and D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Second foal; dam 7f/1m winner (including AW; RPR 91); hooded for his belated debut
runners.name: Ice To Meet You
runners.spotlight: 4yo by Postponed; second foal; dam 7f/1m winner (including AW; RPR 91), half-sister to winners Delicate Kiss (1m) and Kiss And Run (5f), out of useful 1m-1m2f winner; hooded for his belated debut.

runners.comment: Showed some ability when sixth at Kempton over 1m on his debut; open to improvement
runners.name: Marquessofanglesey
runners.owner: Julie Martin & David R Martin & Partner
runners.spotlight: Dam 7f/1m winner (RPR 83); showed some ability when sixth of 13 at Kempton (1m, AW; 9-1) in October; drops in trip on his first start since and he's open to improvement.

runners.comment: Always behind on his debut at Ascot last summer; switches to the AW having been off since
runners.name: Beau Chevalier
runners.spotlight: 150-1 and he was always behind following a slow start at Ascot (7f, good to firm) on his debut last summer; switches to the AW having been off since.

runners.comment: Showed ability in all four starts last year and ran another fine race on his return
runners.name: Red Spells Danger
runners.spotlight: Showed ability in all four starts last year, including when sixth in a competitive race at York in October, and ran another fine race when second of 11 in a maiden at Catterick (7f, good) on his return 15 days ago; good claims if coping with the switch to AW.

runners.comment: Runner-up over 7f/5f here on his two starts; steps back up in distance
runners.name: Ay Up Duck
runners.spotlight: Encouraging debut when chasing home the red-hot favourite in a C&D maiden on his debut and he ran to a similar level here over 5f two weeks ago; has hung right in both starts but should benefit from stepping back up to this trip.

runners.comment: Half-brother to seven-time AW winner Whittle Le Woods; watch the betting on his debut
runners.name: Turton
runners.spotlight: 3yo by Ribchester; sixth foal; half-brother to 6f/7f AW winner Whittle Le Woods (RPR 96); dam 7f-10.4f winner (92), half-sister to useful winners Credit Swap (6f-1m1f), Lockantanks (7f-1m) and Seafront (6f), out of 5f 2yo winner; his half-brother won seven times on the AW and he's an interesting newcomer; watch the betting.

runners.comment: Pulled clear with the winner when beaten a neck here over 6f on her return; steps up to 7f
runners.name: Got The Booty
runners.spotlight: Built on her debut when second of ten at Kempton (6f, AW) in September and that form looks solid (split two subsequent winners); pulled clear with the winner when beaten a neck here over 6f on her return two weeks ago and now steps up in trip which may bring about a bit more improvement.

runners.comment: Second foal; dam 1m4f winner (RPR 54); one to note in the betting on her debut
runners.name: Katies Song
runners.spotlight: Second foal; dam 1m4f winner (RPR 54), half-sister to winners Continga (6f 2yo), Flanagans (Italian 5f) and Lily Trotter (2m hurdle), out of Group-placed 7f 2yo winner; one to note in the betting on her debut.

runners.breeder: Pauline Carpentier Scea Ljc Scea LAub
runners.comment: Showed promise on her debut last year but failed to match that on her comeback run
runners.name: Rogue Desire
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise on her debut at Salisbury (7f, good to firm) last August but she wasn't able to build on that on her comeback run at Wolverhampton (7f, AW) 19 days ago; may come on for that but she'll need to.

runners.comment: Fifth at Kempton last time but she went close over this C&D last month; cheekpieces on
runners.name: Irish Incentive
runners.spotlight: Went close in a novice over C&D last month before finishing fifth at Kempton over 1m 17 days ago, not picking up as well as might have been expected early in the straight; the drop back in trip should suit and she has cheekpieces added.

runners.comment: Mostly struggled since entering handicaps; drops in grade with her mark continuing to fall
runners.name: Searchingtheblues
runners.spotlight: Won her first two starts in 7f novice events on the AW but she's mostly struggled since, including when beating only one home at Lingfield (7f, AW) 20 days ago; drops in grade with her mark continuing to fall.

runners.comment: Gained his third AW win when beating On Key over C&D last time; solid claims under penalty
runners.name: Enpassant
runners.spotlight: Gained his third success on the AW when beating On Key over C&D eight days ago, despite hanging left; holds solid claims under a 5lb penalty (due to be 1lb higher in future).

runners.comment: Won four times for his previous stable but well held in two starts for this yard
runners.name: Mereside Madness
runners.spotlight: Won four times for his previous stable, three of which came on the AW at Newcastle; ended his time with that yard with some lesser efforts and he's been well held in two starts for Scott Dixon; dropped another 3lb.

runners.comment: Completed a hat-trick when winning at Thirsk on his return; up 2lb; can remain competitive
runners.name: Mwafaq
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
runners.spotlight: Won two 7f handicaps at Wolverhampton in October and completed the hat-trick when winning on his return at Thirsk (7f, good) 13 days ago; can remain competitive back on the AW following a 2lb rise.

runners.comment: Down the field in four starts since winning over C&D in February; return to form needed
runners.name: Fools Rush In
runners.owner: S Thompson And Mrs R Carr
runners.spotlight: Gained his second C&D success when winning off a 2lb higher mark in February but he's been down the field in four starts since, including when missing the break at Lingfield 27 days ago; return to form is needed.

runners.comment: Three-time course winner; ran well when runner-up here 16 days ago; can again go well
runners.name: Bomb Squad
runners.spotlight: Eight wins on the AW include three at this track (6f/7f), the last win coming off 2lb lower at Wolverhampton last month; ran well when runner-up here 16 days ago and there's no reason why he can't go well again.

runners.comment: Beaten a neck at Nottingham in October but he's struggled since; others are preferred
runners.name: Louie The Legend
runners.spotlight: Two wins from 21 starts; went close at Nottingham (8.5f, heavy) in October but he's struggled since (Flat/jumps), including when well beaten at that same track 15 days ago; drops back to 7f; others are preferred.

runners.comment: 1-15; ran well when third at Kempton in January but below her best there last time
runners.name: Berning Hot
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 15 starts came at Brighton (7f, good) last August but she ran well when third of nine at Kempton (1m, AW) in January; however, she was below her best there 78 days ago and now drops back in trip.

runners.comment: Won three times last year; has struggled since leaving Jane Chapple-Hyam; best watched
runners.name: Adelaide Bay
runners.spotlight: Won three times over 7f on the AW when trained by Jane Chapple-Hyam last year; struggled for Thomas Faulkner this winter and there's been no sign of a revival in two starts for this stable; best watched.

runners.comment: 0-16 but he ran well when runner-up behind Enpassant over C&D eight days ago; place claims
runners.name: On Key
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden but he ran well, albeit did have every chance, when runner-up behind Enpassant over C&D eight days ago; place claims.

20:30.race_name: Summer Social Events At Southwell Racecourse Handicap

runners.comment: 1-12 but she's been in good form since the tongue-tie was fitted in December; contender
runners.name: Moostar
runners.spotlight: One win from 12 starts but she's been back to form since the tongue-tie was fitted, second at Chelmsford and third at Wolverhampton in December before finishing runner-up on her return at Catterick (6f, good) 15 days ago; contender.

runners.comment: Below his best having raced keenly here over 7f last time but should be happier back at 6f
runners.name: Raft Up
runners.spotlight: Placed behind prolific winner Yorkshire Glory at Newcastle on two occasions (February/March) before racing keenly and running below his best here over 7f 16 days ago; should be happier back at 6f.

runners.comment: Struggled in three starts since finishing fourth over C&D in January; others preferred
runners.name: Blackjack
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; fourth of nine over C&D in January but he's struggled in three starts since; another headgear swap; others preferred.

runners.comment: Took step back in the right direction when third in just a hood at Wolverhampton last time
runners.name: Megaphone
runners.spotlight: Had beaten only one rival home in his first four starts for this stable but he took a step back in the right direction when third at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) six days ago when wearing the hood on its own (same today); chance.

runners.comment: 21-race maiden but his last two efforts have been solid; has each-way claims
runners.name: Valsharah
runners.spotlight: 21-race maiden but he was runner-up at Kempton (6f, AW; first-time tongue-tie) last month and posted another solid effort at Wolverhampton 19 days ago; has each-way claims.

runners.comment: Unfortunate not to finish closer here on his penultimate start and ran well three days ago
runners.name: Fircombe Hall
runners.spotlight: Won twice at Wolverhampton (6f) last month and he was unfortunate not to finish closer when sixth over this C&D on his penultimate start; beaten a neck at Newcastle (6f, AW) three days ago and there's no reason why he can't go well again.
